_meta.description: Region calibration for Gorakhpur district, Uttar Pradesh (eastern Indo-Gangetic plain). Kc values and depletion fractions are taken from FAO-56 Table 12 and Table 22; they are NOT invented. GDD phase boundaries are set for the varieties and sowing calendars used in Purvanchal.
sources: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56, Allen et al. 1998 - Table 12 (Kc), Table 22 (root depth and depletion fraction p)
ICAR-NRRI and ANDUAT Kumarganj - rice varietal and phenology guidance for eastern Uttar Pradesh
ICAR-IIWBR Karnal - wheat phenology and stage guidance for the north-eastern plains zone
_meta.note: Soil values here are the FALLBACK only. At runtime the engine queries ISRIC SoilGrids for per-field soil hydraulics and uses these numbers only when that call fails.
_meta.review_note: Phase boundaries carried over from the previous Terai calibration and adjusted for Purvanchal sowing dates. They are literature defaults until a season of local ground truth exists - see the pilot plan.

land_units.description: The customary revenue units of eastern Uttar Pradesh. A farmer in Gorakhpur reads bigha and katha off their khatauni; they do not think in hectares.
land_units.source: Uttar Pradesh revenue standard - 1 pucca bigha = 3025 sq yd = 27,225 sq ft = 0.625 acre. Subdivided 20 katha to the bigha and 20 dhur to the katha, as used across Purvanchal.
land_units.caveat: The bigha is NOT uniform across Uttar Pradesh. This file uses the pucca bigha. A district that measures in kachha bigha or in biswa needs its own region file - do not adjust these constants in place.

soil.description: Indo-Gangetic alluvium of the Saryu/Rapti plain, generally loam to clay loam, with heavy and seasonally waterlogged patches in the low-lying tal areas.

rice.variety: Eastern UP kharif lowland (e.g. Sarju-52, NDR-359, Swarna/MTU-7029)

wheat.variety: North-eastern plains zone irrigated wheat (e.g. HD-2967, DBW-187, HD-3086)
